comment: Single source of truth for what LLM-written SQL may touch. Read by the Go SQL guard (sqlguard-go) and the Python text-to-SQL tool. Keep in sync with db/migrations (a test checks this).

columns.ticker: stock ticker: AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, META, JPM, XOM
columns.name: company name

filings.description: One row per 10-K filing loaded (last three fiscal years per company).

columns.fiscal_year: the company's own fiscal year label (MSFT: year ending June; NVDA: year ending January)
columns.period_end: balance sheet date of the fiscal year

xbrl_facts.description: Annual financial facts from SEC XBRL data: one row per company, concept, unit and annual period.

columns.filing_id: -> filings.id (NULL for older comparatives not in a loaded filing)
columns.fiscal_year: fiscal year of the PERIOD the value describes, in the company's own labelling
columns.period_start: start of the period; NULL for balance-sheet (point in time) values
columns.period_end: end of the period or balance sheet date
columns.value: numeric value in full units (USD, not millions)

notes: Values are in full units: USD 416161000000 means $416.161 billion. Divide by 1e9 for billions.
Always filter unit = 'USD' for dollar amounts (EPS uses 'USD/shares').

fiscal_year is the company's own label. xbrl_facts holds about five fiscal years of history (to FY2025; MSFT and NVDA to FY2026); the filings table holds only the last three 10-Ks per company. MSFT years end in June, NVDA years end in January.
Companies use different tags for the same idea; use the concept lists below and COALESCE or filter with IN (...).
Join companies with xbrl_facts on companies.id = xbrl_facts.company_id and filter by companies.ticker.

A company can report the same measure under more than one tag in the same year (e.g. GOOGL revenue). When you filter concept with IN (...), use max(value) grouped by company and fiscal_year so the amount is not counted twice.
For 'latest' or 'most recent' fiscal year questions use the greatest fiscal_year that exists for that company; years differ between companies.
